stem:
Priya looks into three mirrors at a science exhibition in her school in Pune.
In mirror 1, her image is erect and the same size as her face.
In mirror 2, when she stands close, her image is erect and enlarged.
In mirror 3, her image is always erect and smaller than her face, no matter where she stands.
Which row correctly names the three mirrors?

options.text: mirror 1: convex, mirror 2: plane, mirror 3: concave
mirror 1: plane, mirror 2: concave, mirror 3: convex
mirror 1: concave, mirror 2: convex, mirror 3: plane
mirror 1: plane, mirror 2: convex, mirror 3: concave

teacher.key_rationale: An erect, same-size image indicates a plane mirror (mirror 1). An erect, enlarged image at close range indicates a concave mirror (mirror 2). An erect, diminished image at all distances indicates a convex mirror (mirror 3). Only option B matches this sequence.
